criteria.requirement: Implement ftfy.audit.repair(text,config=None) returning frozen RepairResult(source_sha256,input_length,text,changed,explanation). Call actual fix_and_explain, retain explanation=None when disabled without changing any fixer policy (requires completed explanation-config repair); otherwise freeze steps and verify actual apply_plan replays to the returned result. Hash original Unicode using UTF8 surrogatepass, do not retain original plaintext in result, preserve input/config, distinguish unchanged text from an absent explanation, and do not fabricate generic repair reasons.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
